meta.title: Fix socket exhaustion in GlideClusterClient tests by optimizing connection management
meta.body_summary: Fix CI socket exhaustion by reusing client connections, adding coordinated delays, and adjusting Jest timeouts to prevent resource contention in Valkey GLIDE Node.js tests.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed CI socket exhaustion by reusing connections and adding delays; after review feedback on timeout, PR merged with full matrix passed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 68 changed lines across 3 test files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted test-infrastructure optimization that merged after iterative CI feedback and review.

review_details.concern_detail: afterAll hook exceeded default 5s timeout due to added cleanup delays; CI on Darwin failed, and reviewer pointed to failure logs.
review_details.performance_claim: ~50% reduction in new socket connections via client reuse, plus reduced socket contention.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot effectively addressed socket exhaustion within test infrastructure using connection reuse and strategic delays; CI feedback loop required human intervention to adjust timeout values and run full matrix.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewer inspected test failure logs and commented on timeout issue.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Maintainer manually triggered full matrix CI run to validate the fix on affected Darwin instances.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Socket exhaustion was reproducible via CI failure; but performance claim (50% connection reduction) lacks direct measurement or benchmark; only inference from code changes.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CI timeout failure, Copilot adjusted afterAll hook timeout from default 5s to 10s and later refined cleanup timeout constant based on review feedback.

core_change_summary.description: In TestUtilities.ts, modified testTeardown to reuse existing client connections with health-check ping, and added cleanup delays (10ms, 5ms, etc.) to prevent socket contention. In GlideClient.test.ts and GlideClusterClient.test.ts, added delays between cluster operations and increased afterAll timeout to 10s to avoid Jest timeout.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only test files changed; no production code impact.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: implement connection reuse and cleanup delays in TestUtilities and test files.
Additional socket contention delays added during cluster setup/teardown.
CI full matrix triggered; first run failed with afterAll timeout on Darwin.
Fix: added TIMEOUT (50s) to afterAll, later reduced to 10s via CLEANUP_TIMEOUT constant.
Full matrix passed, review approved, merged.

review_signals.summary: Initiated Full Matrix test on branch to check fix on Darwin instances.
Reported test failure with afterAll timeout exceeding 5s, with log excerpt.
Fixed timeout by adding TIMEOUT constant; noted delay causing longer cleanup.
Questioned if 50000ms too much; sought justification.
Reduced cleanup timeout to 10s with CLEANUP_TIMEOUT constant.
Triggered Full matrix again after new fix.
Full matrix passed with this fix on Darwin instances.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with connection reuse and delay changes.
Maintainer triggered Full Matrix CI; first run failed with afterAll timeout on Darwin.
Copilot fixed timeout by adding TIMEOUT constant.
Reviewer challenged 50s timeout; Copilot reduced to 10s using CLEANUP_TIMEOUT.
Second Full Matrix passed; formal APPROVED review; PR merged.
